description: 2026 de Belly mechanochemical model under the Jilkine comparison lengths, cue geometry/timing, horizons, and phenotype definitions.

metadata.assay_mode: reflection-symmetric extension with matched Rac-dependent protrusion at both ends and removal of rigid translation; not the literally released one-sided assay
metadata.cue_policy: outer 10%; amplitude alpha_cue/alpha0=1; full to 20 s; cosine taper to zero at 40 s
metadata.initialization_policy: production uses the timestep-independent homogeneous algebraic Rac-Rho fixed point; Julia-matched finite warm-up is validation-only
metadata.mca_policy: resting density fixed at 0.1; implied total abundance proportional to L
metadata.model_provenance: VirtualEmbryo/mechanochemical_polarization, 2026 de Belly mechanochemical Rac-Rho-MCA model; reflection-symmetric boundary extension for Jilkine assays

parameter_selection.selection_basis: interior of the persistent spontaneous-polarization regime; 40-s asymmetric cue creates long-lived Rac-front/Rho-back polarity; mechanics removal abolishes persistence; sustained opposing gradient reverses in 75 s at L=15
